about:
Wire Harness Manufacturing operates from Lincoln, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1993. The company provides contract assembly of cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electromechanical assemblies.

The shop handles small to large production volumes with both short-run and weekly production capabilities. In-house equipment includes cut-strip-crimp machines, wire cutting and stripping machines, crimp terminal presses, ultrasonic wire welding equipment, a milling machine for enclosure modifications, and an Artos CR22 automatic crimping wire processor. Services span cable and harness assemblies, ribbon cables, single-wire processing, kitting, hot stamping, heat-shrink labeling, loom and tubing cutting, thermal transfer printing, sonic wire welding, control-box enclosures, and thermal label printing. The company also offers engineering support from prototype through production, using CAD software for design and documentation.

Customers come from scientific equipment, automotive, original equipment manufacturers, transportation, environmental, and agricultural sectors. The firm specializes in helping companies develop concepts or prototypes into production-ready products, providing design, engineering, and vendor-relations expertise.

Wire Harness Manufacturing emphasizes 100% inspection before shipment using Cami Research and custom test fixtures, an experienced purchasing department that sources components for quality and lead time, and trained assemblers to eliminate learning-curve costs. The company says its CAD-driven workflow enables fast, accurate design changes and documentation.
